title: WaterColor "Casa de Buttercup" 120 Buttercup Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Located in WaterColor's Park District- Smart TVs in every bedroom and the living room- Furnished porch- 3 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Traditional elegance is what you will find in this Park District home with accommodations for 6. Fall in love with the outdoors as you sit on the porch and relax. This home features elegant hardwoods, beautiful furnishings, and charming touches throughout. The gourmet kitchen offers creamy white cabinets, granite countertops, two sinks, and everything you need for an amazing meal. Dining just off of the kitchen has seating for 6 on a beautiful dark wood table surrounded by windows. The living room has a comfortable feel for relaxing while watching the television. Cozy reading nooks will help you melt into that favorite book you have been waiting to enjoy. The primary suite offers a king bed and flat-screen television with DVD player and also boasts an adjoining bath with shower and double vanity. Just down the hall is another king room with television and connecting bath that is shared with the hall. The bath features a single vanity, tub, and a shower. The third bedroom has a king bed and features a flat-screen television and an adjoining bath with single vanity and a shower.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Tub and Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Per HOA Policy, all Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one Low-Speed Vehicle per home. Homes with owner provided Low-Speed Vehicles are not permitted to rent an additional Low-Speed Vehicle.The fireplace is not for guest use.
